scope: Bounded catalog metadata/payload selection and RPC serialization; synthetic single-node RF=1

implementation.summary: Metadata only for valid cached/new rows; bounded legacy fallback when required
implementation.continuation: Before every unreturned metadata candidate; partial reads retry the incoming interval

before.application: Cassandra retained full attribute pages from eight shards before merging; PostgreSQL returned complete attribute pages even for SUMMARY
before.server_repeat: The first capped RPC run passed. After the broader contract/schema suite, repeating it failed during seed projection 6; Docker reported server exit 137, OOMKilled=true under the 1GiB cap. Preserved failed client log and final server log excerpt.
before.allocation_attribution: The exact responsible allocations were not isolated. Netty's separate direct allowance and arena sizes were subsequently reduced/unified; the complete repeated sequence then passed.

sequence: Both List contract bucket layouts, schedule changes, backfill and upgrade tests on the same Cassandra server
Repeat 512MiB native RPC + large legacy repair + 32-event large outbox backlog on that server

limits: Server memory still reaches its configured ceiling; raw memory.events/peak/RSS are preserved in runtime.json
RPC fixture injects trusted test caller scopes and seeds read projections, not the complete canonical ingest path
No public HTTP/gateway, concurrent full replies, Get(SUMMARY), disk processor or broker/consumer combination
No intended separate-kernel k3s RF=3, full-feed p95/60x catch-up or complete reference acceptance
